tasks.label: Build GUI application (offline)
args: set -e; export PATH="/ucrt64/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:$PATH"; if grep -nE '<property name="flag">[^<]*wxEXPAND[^<]*wxALIGN_|<property name="flag">[^<]*wxALIGN_[^<]*wxEXPAND' ClientformOrderPesanan.fbp; then echo 'Invalid wxSizerFlags: wxEXPAND cannot be combined with wxALIGN_*; fix the flags in the form designer.' >&2; exit 1; fi; "/e/wxFormBuilder-4.2.1-i686/wxFormBuilder.exe" --generate ClientformOrderPesanan.fbp; mkdir -p build; cp src/disabled.png src/focus.png src/pressed.png src/current.png build/; windres src/app.rc -O coff -o build/app-res.o; g++ $(wx-config --cxxflags) -std=c++17 -g -Wall -Wextra src/main.cpp src/Frame_Base.cpp build/app-res.o -o build/ClientformOrderPesanan.exe $(wx-config --libs) -mwindows
tasks.detail: Validates wxSizerFlags, regenerates the UI from ClientformOrderPesanan.fbp, then builds with local wxFormBuilder and MSYS2 UCRT64 wxWidgets.

tasks.label: Generate wxFormBuilder UI
tasks.detail: Run only after changing ClientformOrderPesanan.fbp; uses the locally installed wxFormBuilder.
